mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_task( record_type, task_domain, task_key, task_status, input_snapshot, output_snapshot, snapshot_retention_until, started_at, result_entity_type ) VALUES( 'REPORT_SCHEDULE_RUN', 'REPORT', CONCAT('REPORT_SCHEDULE:', UUID()), 'RUNNING', JSON_OBJECT('scheduleKey', #{row.key}, 'reportType', #{row.type}, 'periodStart', #{row.periodStart}, 'periodEnd', #{row.periodEnd}), JSON_OBJECT('lockAcquired', 1), DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL 365 DAY), NOW(3), 'AI_REPORT' )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_task SET task_status = 'SUCCEEDED', result_entity_id = #{report}, output_snapshot = JSON_OBJECT('lockAcquired', 1, 'reportId', #{report}), completed_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND record_type = 'REPORT_SCHEDULE_RUN' AND task_status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE t_ai_task SET task_status = 'SKIPPED_LOCK', output_snapshot = JSON_OBJECT('lockAcquired', 0), completed_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND record_type = 'REPORT_SCHEDULE_RUN' AND task_status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE t_ai_task SET task_status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{code}, error_detail = #{message}, completed_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND record_type = 'REPORT_SCHEDULE_RUN' AND task_status = 'RUNNING'
